The primary return model is an explicit earnings-to-cash-to-capital-to-dilution model, not a P/E target with funding ignored. The terminal common-equity value is normalized annual earnings after interest and tax multiplied by 12 x/20 x/28 x for bear/base/bull. No interim dividends are assumed. The main value conservatively excludes terminal cash because part is unused hypothetical financing; a separate alternative credits only cash above the modeled minimum, with a complete provenance bridge. Debt is already reflected in earnings through interest, so it is not subtracted again from a P/E equity value. Historical EV/EBITDA, book support and a haircut asset-recovery diagnostic are independent cross-checks. No DCF/WACC precision is claimed.

The seed parameters, all dated rows and formulas are embedded in canonical.json. Key conventions:

- Audited opening date 31 March 2026; monthly calendar boundaries, plus an exact 20 October 2026 entry boundary and 20 October 2031 exit. Period length is actual days/365.25. Run-rate sales compound by the scenario growth rate; period sales are the mean of opening/closing annual run rates times period length.
- EBITDA margin fades from 22.4539% to 12%/19%/22.5% over 730.5 days. Tax is 25% of positive profit, with no assumed immediate benefit for tax losses. Existing depreciation is ₹2.024 cr/year; new operating capex is depreciated over 7 years and development over 5 years, never beyond each vintage’s remaining balance. Original development amortization begins 1 April 2027 as an assumption. Terminal earnings use terminal sales and the following 12 months of remaining depreciation/amortization at flat revenue.
- DSO/DIO/DPO move from opening balance-implied days to bear 120/210/45, base 95/165/55, bull 75/120/60 over 365.25 days. Inventory/payables use modeled operating cost(revenue less EBITDA); this is not statutory material-only COGS. Other operating WC scales with sales. Opening ONWC ₹72.3181 cr excludes tax and plant advances. Every change consumes/releases cash.
- Tangible/intangible operating capex is 2.5%/4%/5% of sales; additional development is 1%/1.5%/2%. The outstanding ₹6 cr land payment is assumed 30 June 2026; opening ₹7.0497 crtax is assumed 30 September 2026, separately from tax on new profits. Dates are stress assumptions, not claimed actual payments.
- Interest uses opening debt at 12%/9.5%/9% perannum; end-period debt draws incur interest from the next period. Annual principal ₹1.5144 cr is paid proportionately. Most short-term WC debt is assumed renewed, not proven long-dated. A separate nonrenewal stress calls ₹30.31 cr on 31 October 2027 and removes unused headroom. Minimum cash ismax(₹2 cr,1% annual run rate sales).
- Stale March bank headroom ₹3.68 cr can be drawn only once. Unfunded cases stop at the first remaining reserve gap. Funded cases assume gross proposed issue ₹132.59136 cr less 2% fees and remaining warrant exercise ₹23.025375 cr on 20 October 2026. Neither is committed cash. No earlier warrant deposit is counted again.
- Hypothetical rescue occurs when reserve funding is needed, at ₹876/share(default)and 5% issuance cost, up to ₹300 crgross cumulative. Rescue shares are rounded up to whole shares and proceeds are recomputed. A ₹350/share stress tests distress dilution. This cap bounds the illustration; there is no assertion of an available investor or any ability to raise that amount.
- Ordinary monthly cases assume evenly flowing operations/closing period funding; theydo not prove intramonth solvency. A dedicated cash-calls-first case pays supplier/WC, interest, tax, capex, land and principal before customer collections, with borrowing/rescue at period start. Preference/warrant receipts remain unavailable until their dated event. Each row retains collections, cashcalls, trough and reserve funding test.
